# Build a free electronic press kit

> Build a professional electronic press kit (EPK) for your band or artist project in minutes — bio, streaming links, tour dates, press quotes, and photo. Free, no signup, runs entirely in your browser. Download a shareable HTML one-sheet or copy a plain-text version for email.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
